scope: Fresh local WordPress installation: packaged theme 1.9.0, plugin 1.8.0. Chromium, read-only, all POST requests blocked before transmission. Live hosting inspection is handled separately by the root agent.

steps.health: Clear responsive two-line hero and centered mobile tariffs; minor delivery qualification below.
Readable, logical hierarchy and order; centered availability note is prominent.
Centered process and connected steps are clear; delivery information precedes calculator.
Calculator is understandable; optional games have weak hierarchy.
Catalog search works; empty-state instructions point to a hidden field.
Name, phone, and address use 16px text and clear labels; street interaction is handled by the separate bug audit.
Native full legal texts are consistent; mini privacy dialogue contains stale information.

findings.title: Empty search directs the visitor to a closed field
findings.reproduce: Search any unlisted title while the missing-game accordion is closed. The input count is 0, but the text says to leave the title above.
findings.recommendation: Use an obvious empty-state action to request the searched title. Open and focus the named field; avoid pointing to a hidden input.

findings.title: Contact placeholders have low text contrast
findings.recommendation: Increase the placeholder foreground to at least 4.5:1 against the normal input surface, retaining existing 16px text and labels.

findings.title: Optional games section looks detached from calculator
findings.measurement: Existing 13px field label on the far left and 14px pill on the far right, with an explanatory line below; the desktop empty state spans 753px.
findings.recommendation: Group heading, optional status, short helper text, and action in one compact section. Show selected games directly below; make the mobile action full width.

findings.title: Privacy mini-dialogue still describes old fields
findings.quote: Ім’я, телефон або Telegram, місто й адреса / Имя, телефон или Telegram, город и адрес
findings.recommendation: Describe actual field types: name, phone, address, rental parameters, security choice, and game wishes. The native managed full privacy page is already correct.

findings.title: Tariff delivery badges omit geographic condition
findings.measurement: Tariffs say delivery is included; the later delivery section limits this benefit to green and yellow zones and charges red-zone delivery by taxi.
findings.recommendation: If clarifying, specify zones within the existing badge or an accessible explanation. Respect the user’s removal of the duplicate section footnote.

fonts.result: All six cases load all three fonts. No fallback or garbled glyphs were seen; there is no justification for replacing the typefaces. Normal content is 13–16px; eyebrows are 9–11px and carry supplementary labels. Contact, search, and wishlist text inputs are 16px.

structureRecommendation: Keep the existing sequence: hero → tariffs → games → kit → how it works / delivery → calculator → contacts / footer. Improve optional games within the calculator instead of adding another main section.
limits: No actual request submission, orders, or emails.
No physical iPhone / Safari / keyboard testing. Chromium mobile viewports validate CSS rendering only.
No claim of full accessibility compliance or exhaustive interaction testing.
No fresh screenshot of the lower part of every expanded FAQ answer. All eight answers in both languages were inspected in the fresh live DOM and source; two expanded viewport captures are included.
